transitions: a cut to a new board or an inset is another.
labels: One geometric sans (e.g. Jost): titles 600 all caps with ~0.12 em tracking, numbers 400 large (~44 px), units at half size. All text has a ~7 px halo in the ground colour so it reads over any block.
Label pins: dot (ink ring, pale fill) → vertical leader → horizontal rule → text. Pins point up or down, left or right, chosen per station so labels never cover the subject.
Titles can be isometric type on a world plane, extruded as blocks.

The subtitle is a map label: a pale card with a small radius and an ink border, a tiny iso cube as legend chip, sans ~42 px, bottom-centre; border draws first, text wipes in. Keep the bottom ~170 px clear for it. Hold ≥ max(1.8 s, speech + 0.6 s); lines never overlap titles or other lines.
motion: Nothing moves without a line leading it: a route line is drawn slightly ahead, a leader grows before an inset opens, a cut line draws before a skin slides away.
Cutaway: cut line (~0.3 s) → the near skin slides out along its normal and fades (~0.35 s, ease-out) → hatched section rims fade in over the last part.
Isotype fill: icons pop with a back-ease (overshoot), one per subdivision of the beat; count-up numbers run over the same span.

Accumulation = acceleration: arrivals on quarter notes, then eighths, then waves; the eye feels the system taking over. Solids arrive by motion, never by alpha (semi-transparent blocks look like ghosts).

native_moves.name: Cutaway
native_moves.does: Cut line, skin slides away, hatched rims remain.
native_moves.fits: a heart's chambers; a server rack; a beehive.

native_moves.name: Isotype number
native_moves.does: Identical icons in a new arrangement each time (a calendar, a bar, a silhouette formed by the icons themselves).
native_moves.fits: votes in an election; litres of water per product; users of an app.

native_moves.name: Focus + context
native_moves.fits: one patient in a hospital; one packet in a network; one tree in a forest.

native_moves.name: Frame within the frame
native_moves.does: A leader grows into a circular inset with a close-up.
native_moves.fits: a chip on a circuit board; a worker's hands; a crack in a bridge.

native_moves.name: Scale reveal
native_moves.does: Pull back until every label is on screen and the last frame is a finished infographic.
native_moves.fits: how a city is powered; a school's day; a festival site.

native_moves.name: Tracked subject
native_moves.does: One object followed with a "you are here" ring.
native_moves.fits: a letter through the post; a drop through a water plant; a vaccine dose.

native_moves.name: Strata cross-section
native_moves.does: The board's edge becomes the story (layers added or removed).
native_moves.fits: a mine; an archaeological dig; a building's floors.
